title: Change the details on a liquor licence
summary: Update the contact details on your liquor licence online if you have the necessary authorisation.
intro:
If you want to update the contact details on your liquor licence and you have the necessary authorisation, you can update online.

For up-to-date liquor licence guidelines, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor licensing contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: Must hold a NSW liquor licence and be listed as a licensee.
what_you_need: Personal and contact details (if an individual)
Name, ABN, ACN, and contact details (if an organisation)

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to update your details.

faqs.q: Where can I find up-to-date liquor licence guidelines and resources?
faqs.a: Visit the Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing page.

faqs.q: Who should I contact if I have questions about liquor licensing?
How do I update my liquor licence details online?
faqs.a: Select 'Apply online', enter your liquor licence details, select the 'Update your details' section, and follow the prompts.
